clue.text: Thought about getting cold, wrapped in a thin sheet

parts.note: re is a short way of saying about or concerning

indicators.note: wrapped in says the cold letter goes inside the thin sheet, enclosed by it

parts.note: a membrane is a thin pliable sheet of tissue or material
C is the standard abbreviation for cold, as on a tap

explanation.surface: Someone muses on catching a chill while lying wrapped in a flimsy sheet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrapped in' signals the insertion; 'getting' is only a link word, and 'Thought' is a noun here, a memory.
explanation.definitionFit: Remembrance is recollection, a thought held about something past.

clue.text: Show a Greek character about half dozen

indicators.note: about means the Greek letter goes round the six, enclosing it

parts.note: eta is a letter of the Greek alphabet
half a dozen is six, VI in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A Greek actor appears in a show around half a dozen times.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' signals the container; 'Show' is a noun, a stage musical, not the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Evita is a well-known stage musical, i.e. a theatre show.

clue.text: Not all of the men dedicated to reform effected reform

indicators.note: Not all of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some of the men committed to change actually brought change about.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition took in 'to reform', which is surface; the definition is 'effected reform', past tense to match. 'Not all of' signals EMENDED inside thE MEN DEDicated.
explanation.definitionFit: To emend is to correct or improve a text, so having done so is having carried out a reform.

clue.text: After call-up receive an allowance

indicators.note: After places the word for receive behind the reversed call
in a down clue up means the word is written bottom to top, i.e. backwards

parts.note: to dub someone is to call or name them
to get something is to receive it

explanation.surface: Once conscripted, a soldier is given an allowance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'call-up' looks like conscription, but it is DUB turned 'up' to make BUD.
explanation.definitionFit: A budget is a sum of money allotted for spending, an allowance.

clue.text: Assert it's different for entertainers

indicators.note: different says the letters are made into a new arrangement

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Someone claims that performers are a breed apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'different' rearranges ASSERTITS.
explanation.definitionFit: Artistes are professional performers such as singers or dancers.

clue.text: Willing to consider temporary accommodation

parts.note: to con is an old word for studying or considering closely
a tent is a shelter put up for a short stay

explanation.surface: Someone is prepared to think about staying in makeshift lodgings.
explanation.definitionFit: To be content to do something is to be willing or happy to do it.

clue.text: Person going jogging plainly embarrassed to be found in the garden

parts.note: going scarlet shows embarrassment openly
a runner is someone out jogging

explanation.surface: A red-faced jogger is discovered among the flowerbeds.
explanation.walkthrough: The scarlet runner is a climbing bean grown in British vegetable gardens.
explanation.definitionFit: The scarlet runner is a common climbing bean, a vegetable plant grown in gardens.

clue.text: Contend one's a king in the river

indicators.note: in means these pieces are placed inside the name of the river

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain
one is I, so one's is I'S, read as I is
GR stands for Georgius Rex, King George

explanation.surface: Someone argues that a monarch is located in the river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts ISAGR inside DEE.
explanation.definitionFit: To disagree is to argue or dispute, which is what contending means.

clue.text: French and German articles on status making sense

parts.note: un is the French indefinite article
der is a German definite article
standing is rank or status

explanation.surface: Grammar notes on how French and German use articles finally become clear.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue the two articles sit 'on' (above) STANDING.
explanation.definitionFit: Understanding is comprehension, the faculty of grasping meaning.

clue.text: Agree with a man in the church

indicators.note: in means the man's word sits inside the letters for the church

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
him is a male pronoun, standing for a man

explanation.surface: Someone sides with a fellow in church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' signals the container; CE is the Church of England, and church bells make the surface apt.
explanation.definitionFit: To chime with something is to be in harmony with it, to concur.

clue.text: Withholding it need not seem improper

indicators.note: improper says the letters are not in their proper order

explanation.surface: Keeping something back need not look wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'improper' rearranges ITNEEDNOT; 'seem' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Detention is the keeping back of something or someone, holding it in custody.

clue.text: Forward a note in compensation

indicators.note: in means the pieces go inside the word for compensation

parts.note: redress is compensation for a wrong
D is a musical note

explanation.surface: Someone sends on a written note about a claim for damages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts AD inside REDRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: To readdress a letter is to put a new address on it and send it on, to forward it.

clue.text: A skinhead put inside before will arrange to get out

indicators.note: put inside says the A and the head letter are placed within the word for before

parts.note: ere is an old word for before
the head of skin is its first letter, S

explanation.surface: A shaven-headed thug, jailed earlier, plans to escape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put inside' places AS within ERE; 'skinhead' is not a thug but the head of 'skin'. 'will arrange to' is linking surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To erase is to rub out or remove, getting rid of a mark.

clue.text: Directions given to copper gathering cash abroad

parts.note: E and S are compass directions, east and south
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
a do is a party or social gathering

explanation.surface: A policeman is given instructions while collecting money overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'copper' looks like a policeman but is the metal Cu.
explanation.definitionFit: The escudo was the currency of Portugal, foreign money from a British viewpoint.

clue.text: A number edge in, almost all delinquent

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
a rim is an edge

indicators.note: almost means the word all loses its last letter

explanation.surface: Several are on the brink of being drawn in, nearly every one a wrongdoer.
explanation.definitionFit: A delinquent is an offender, someone who breaks the law.

clue.text: Brings back military personnel and supplies

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
stores are supplies kept for use

explanation.surface: Army quartermasters return troops and equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: To restore is to return something to its former place or state.

clue.text: Guy in charge of an animal causing chaos among transport on the road

definitions.text: Guy in charge of an animal

indicators.note: among means the chaos word sits inside the transport word

parts.note: a car is road transport
a melee is a chaotic scramble

explanation.surface: A man leading a beast causes havoc in the traffic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'among' signals the container; 'causing' is only a link word between definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A cameleer drives or leads camels, so he is a handler of beasts.

clue.text: Form of protection for actor in a play

indicators.note: play suggests the letters are set loose and rearranged

explanation.surface: An actor in a drama needs some sort of cover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'play' rearranges ACTORINA.
explanation.definitionFit: A raincoat is a coat that protects the wearer from rain.

clue.text: Foster being rich, he's rude

indicators.note: rude in the sense of rough or crude marks the letters as needing reshaping

explanation.surface: A wealthy man is impolite while raising a child.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rude' rearranges RICHHES; 'being' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To foster a hope or feeling is to nurture and hold it dear.

clue.text: The picture-making equipment arrived ahead of the artist

indicators.note: ahead of puts the word for arrived first, before the artist

parts.note: came is the past tense of come, arrived
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: Photo gear got here before the painter did.
explanation.definitionFit: A camera is the device used to take photographs.

clue.text: Given employment after a set-back or agitated

indicators.note: after places the employment word behind the other pieces
set-back means the word or is written backwards

parts.note: taken as written
something given employment has been used

explanation.surface: A worker hired after a reversal feels stirred up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set-back' turns OR into RO.
explanation.definitionFit: Aroused means stirred up or excited, as an agitated person is.

clue.text: A fool surrounded by a little beast's refuse

indicators.note: surrounded by means the fool word sits inside the word for the little beast

parts.note: a pup is a young animal
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A fool sits beside a puppy's rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'refuse' looks like rubbish but is the verb, to decline.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass up an offer is to decline it.

clue.text: A sound description!

parts.note: read as a term covering any audible sound, a general word for what is heard

explanation.definitionFit: Noise is any sound, especially a loud one, so the word describes sound.

clue.text: In love — the changed demeanour shows it

indicators.note: changed says the letters are put into a different order

explanation.surface: A lover's altered behaviour gives the game away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' rearranges DEMEANOUR; 'shows it' is linking surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To be enamoured is to be smitten, charmed by someone.

clue.text: Concerned with the morning's paper

parts.note: re means concerning or about
a.m. stands for morning, so morning's gives AM'S

explanation.surface: A story about the morning newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: Paper is the definition: reams are large quantities of paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A ream is a fixed quantity of sheets, so reams are a lot of writing material.

clue.text: They look for answers to cut back by pitmen

indicators.note: back means the word for cut is read in reverse

parts.note: to axe is to cut
pitmen are coal miners

explanation.surface: Pitmen's jobs are to be slashed, and they want answers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns AXE into EXA; 'by' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Examiners set and mark tests, seeking correct replies from candidates.

clue.text: A health resort in the country

parts.note: a spa is a resort with mineral springs

explanation.surface: Someone takes a break at a wellness retreat out in the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Spain is a European nation.

clue.text: An individual trained to work on a personal basis

definitions.text: An individual trained to work on a personal basis

parts.words: An individual trained to work on a personal basis
parts.note: the personal basis is read literally as the base of a person, the feet, which this professional treats

explanation.surface: A tutor or trainer who works with clients one to one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'personal basis' sounds like one-to-one service, but means a person's feet.
explanation.definitionFit: A chiropodist is a professional who treats ailments of the feet.
